name: MFI
description: This keyword returns the Money Flow Index value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the  Money Flow Index  value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632143286.png)

The above condition is checking if the Previous day(-1) MFI value is greater than 80 for Nifty 50 futures.

The Money Flow Index (MFI) is a technical oscillator that uses price and volume data for identifying overbought or oversold signals in an asset.

Read more about  Money Flow Index (MFI)  here - https://www.investopedia.com/terms/m/mfi.asp
